visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a blue robot cat character (Doraemon) peeking from behind a plush red curtain on a dark stage. Bright yellow and pink text overlays appear at the top. (2) A series of rapid cuts show various three-dimensional statues of the same character: one with a large translucent bubble from its nose, another flattened on a blue platform reading a book, and one wearing a yellow shirt and raising its arms. The background is a brightly lit indoor gallery with white walls and blue flooring. (3) The montage continues, showcasing stylized versions of the character, including one in a red magician's robe with a wand, one with a large afro, and another with exaggerated red lips. (4) The scene shifts to an exhibit featuring a detailed office desk setup with a lamp, globe, and papers, while a cutout of the character is projected on the wall. (5) A tour through a manga exhibition area reveals large black-and-white art panels and an archway made of manga volumes. (6) A collection of diverse statues is shown in a row, followed by a 'muscle-bound' version of the character and another performing a handstand on a giant book. (7) The camera pans through a merchandise store filled with shelves of plushies, cushions, and bags. (8) The final shots show a massive inflatable version of the character outdoors in a grassy park, followed by close-ups of two statues making funny faces against a blue background.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a vibrant promotional piece for the '100% Doraemon & FRIENDS' exhibition in Taipei. By utilizing a high-speed montage of various creative statues, gallery spaces, and exclusive merchandise, it aims to generate excitement and urge viewers to purchase tickets for the event.
